import pptxgenjs as pptx
import datetime

# Create a new Presentation
pres = pptx.Presentation()
pres.title = "Incredible India"
pres.author = "TITAN"

# Slide 1: Title Slide (Cover Slide)
slide1 = pres.add_slide()
slide1.add_text("Incredible India: A Journey Through Diversity", {"x": 0.5, "y": 1.5, "w": "90%", "h": 1.0, "font_size": 48, "bold": True, "align": "center", "color": "000000"})
slide1.add_text("Exploring Culture, History, and Innovation", {"x": 0.5, "y": 3.0, "w": "90%", "h": 0.5, "font_size": 24, "align": "center", "color": "555555"})
slide1.background = {"fill": "F0F0F0"} # Light background

# Slide 2: Diversity and Culture (Content Slide 1)
slide2 = pres.add_slide()
slide2.add_text("Diversity and Culture", {"x": 0.5, "y": 0.5, "w": "90%", "h": 0.5, "font_size": 32, "bold": True, "color": "000000"})
slide2.add_list(["Vibrant Festivals and Traditions", "Unity in Diversity: Languages and Religions", "Rich Heritage and Arts", "Cuisine: A Culinary Delight"], {"x": 0.8, "y": 1.5, "w": "80%", "h": 3.0, "font_size": 20})
slide2.background = {"fill": "FFFFFF"}

# Slide 3: History and Heritage (Content Slide 2)
slide3 = pres.add_slide()
slide3.add_text("History and Heritage", {"x": 0.5, "y": 0.5, "w": "90%", "h": 0.5, "font_size": 32, "bold": True, "color": "000000"})
slide3.add_list(["Ancient Civilizations (Indus Valley)", "Architectural Marvels (Taj Mahal, Forts)", "Struggle for Independence", "Birthplace of Spirituality"], {"x": 0.8, "y": 1.5, "w": "80%", "h": 3.0, "font_size": 20})

# Slide 4: Modern India & Innovation (Content Slide 3)
slide4 = pres.add_slide()
slide4.add_text("Modern India and Innovation", {"x": 0.5, "y": 0.5, "w": "90%", "h": 0.5, "font_size": 32, "bold": True, "color": "000000"})
slide4.add_list(["Leading in AI & Generative AI", "Thriving Tech Hubs and Startups", "Space Exploration Achievements", "Economic Growth and Global Influence"], {"x": 0.8, "y": 1.5, "w": "80%", "h": 3.0, "font_size": 20})

# Slide 5: Conclusion (Interactive/Fatafat style - Summary)
slide5 = pres.add_slide()
slide5.add_text("Conclusion: Dynamic and Resilient", {"x": 0.5, "y": 1.5, "w": "90%", "h": 1.0, "font_size": 36, "bold": True, "align": "center", "color": "000000"})
slide5.add_text("Experience the synergy of tradition and future!", {"x": 0.5, "y": 3.0, "w": "90%", "h": 0.5, "font_size": 24, "align": "center", "color": "555555"})

# Save the presentation to the Desktop path
output_path = "C:/Users/achal/Desktop/Incredible_India_Presentation.pptx"
pres.save(output_path)
print(f"Presentation saved to {output_path}")
